title: Y80 save: initial screenshots, coaching recording and owner facts (backfilled)
about: Backfilled record of everything uploaded before the pipeline existed. Bulk stats are recorded as baselines (the file states the history starts from); every owner fact, nickname and sprite look is an explicit mutation, so applying this manifest to the current data is a no-op and the audit can trace each text field to it.
